control.description-key: Entry field for sensitive numbers such as bank accounts and SIN. Typed characters are masked, the clipboard is blocked, and the value must be entered twice before it is stored.

property.name: value
property.description-key: Text column that receives the entered value

property.name: characters
property.description-key: Which characters may be typed. Digits only is the default.

property.name: validation
property.description-key: Extra check before the value is stored. SIN requires nine digits with a valid Luhn checksum.

property.name: maxLength
property.description-key: Longest value that can be typed. Zero means no limit. Ignored when validation is SIN, which is always nine.

property.name: layout
property.description-key: Auto puts Enter and Enter again side by side when the control is at least 480 pixels wide and stacks them otherwise.

property.name: revealMs
property.description-key: How long the character just typed stays readable before it is masked. Zero masks at once.
